summary: Validated with validate --run <run> --submission update46.json returning valid=true. This record corrects a loose example in my own verification finding and, in doing so, widens its applicability. The threshold is the voter quorum, computed as voters divided by two plus one (raft.go:1084-1094), and the verification path seeds the count with the leader's own vote before registering the request (raft.go:965-974). With three voters the threshold is two, so the leader plus a single acknowledging non-voter reaches it; my earlier example required two non-voters, which overstated the premise, and the paused handoff repeated that looseness. More generally, with V voters the threshold is V/2 plus one and the leader supplies one, so the required non-voter acknowledgements equal the threshold minus one, which is one for the common three and four voter configurations. Recorded as one Fact plus a successor interpretation for the same question, with the earlier example and the handoff wording preserved alongside the correction. Everything else stands as recorded: the threshold comes from voters, acknowledgements are not filtered by suffrage, the deviation is from the documented audience of the heartbeat, the operational window remains bounded by the lease check, and severity stays conditional on the timing and configuration conditions already stated. Counterevidence kept explicit: the correction changes applicability rather than mechanism, deviation or window; the arithmetic assumes the leader is a voter in the configuration it checks against, which is the normal case; the non-voter must still be reachable; and nothing was executed, since this run had no experiment capacity at any point during my work. No stop declaration is made, as budget expiry is a controller boundary.
